facts.business: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited is an integrated speciality chemicals manufacturer with expertise across sulphur, boron and ethanol chemistry, catering to industries such as pharmaceuticals, detergents, dyes, pigments, cosmetics, water treatment and industrial applications.

capacity_or_capex.item: Boric Acid production capacity increase at Dahej plant
Production line capacity increase at Roha plant
Waste heat recovery system in oleum section (pinch technology)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company carries no major capital expenditure obligations and has the assets, capabilities and capacity to grow as conditions normalise.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Litigations and claims pending with multiple tax authorities (Income Tax, Excise, GST, Customs) and labour law cases, plus litigation filed by Shipping Corporation of India Limited claiming ₹2.48 crore plus interest.

key_risks: Pending litigations and claims with tax authorities and labour law cases
Litigation by Shipping Corporation of India Limited claiming ₹2.48 crore plus interest
